citation_nap.name: AfriShield AI
citation_nap.note: Type the street as one string in the form's Address field - never split it across Postcode. Use 0000 for Postcode only where the form refuses to save without it; leave it blank wherever it is optional. address.postal_code stays empty so the site's JSON-LD never emits a postal code that does not exist. GBP is a service-area business with the address hidden, so this street address is published on directories only, not on the Google profile.
citation_nap.map_pin: UNSET - drag to Kotto, then record lat/lng in the geo field

pricing.source_of_truth: https://afrishieldai.com/pricing - published with ProfessionalService + OfferCatalog schema, priceRange 'USD 150-900 per month'
pricing.terms: Month to month, 30 days notice, no setup fee, no minimum term. Invoiced in NGN, GHS, KES, ZAR or XAF on request.

directory_values.why: Directory 'minimum project size' means minimum TOTAL ENGAGEMENT value, not the monthly rate - a different unit, so $1,000+ and $150/month are both true at once. Foundation over seven months is about $1,050; Engine over three is $1,200. B2B directories also treat a low minimum as a quality signal against you, and several do not offer a bracket below $1,000 at all. So: state $1,000+ on directories, keep the real monthly tiers public on the site, and never raise the published monthly price to make a directory field agree.
directory_values.hourly_note: We do not bill hourly. Choose 'Undisclosed' or 'N/A' wherever a platform allows it; use the band above only when the field is mandatory.

pricing.known_inconsistency: Sortlist currently shows 'A partir de 1 000 EUR' (~USD 1,080). That is the right ORDER but the wrong unit and currency - it reads as a price floor rather than an engagement minimum, on the profile that ranks #2 for 'agence SEO Douala'. Review the field wording and set it in USD if the platform allows.
